label: Councillor opinion
summary: Changes how much the character's councillors like them.
details: The amount can be negative. Works on a character.

label: Counter efficiency
summary: Changes the efficiency of the character's men-at-arms counters.
details: The game's display text is the men-at-arms counter concept followed by Efficiency. Works on a character and on terrain.

label: Counter resistance
summary: Changes the resistance of the character's men-at-arms to counters.
details: The game's display text is the men-at-arms counter concept followed by Resistance. Works on a character and on terrain.

label: Fertility consumption
summary: Changes by a flat amount how fast a county's fertility is consumed each month.
details: The game text calls this side of fertility consumption. It works on a character (going by the area, their counties), a province or a county. A negative amount slows the loss.

label: Fertility consumption (percent)
summary: Changes by a percentage how fast a county's fertility is consumed each month.
details: Same effect as the flat version, but as a percentage. Works on a character, a province or a county.

label: Fertility growth
summary: Changes by a flat amount how fast a county's fertility grows each month.
details: A higher value means faster growth. Works on a character (going by the area, their counties), a province or a county.

label: Fertility growth (percent)
summary: Changes by a percentage how fast a county's fertility grows each month.
details: Scales the growth instead of adding a flat amount. Works on a character, a province or a county.

label: County opinion
summary: Changes by a flat amount the county opinion, how much the people of a county like their ruler.
details: Works on a character, a province or a county. A negative amount lowers it.

label: County opinion (even if baron)
summary: Changes county opinion by a flat amount, and also applies when the character is only a baron.
details: The game gives it the same display text as the plain county opinion modifier. Going by its name, the plain one is limited by rank and this one is not. Works on a character.

label: Court grandeur bonus
summary: Adds a flat amount to the character's court grandeur baseline.
details: The game's display text is Court Grandeur Bonus. Works on a character.

label: Courtier and guest opinion
summary: Changes how much the character's courtiers and guests like them.
details: Covers both groups at once. The amount can be negative. Works on a character.

label: Courtier opinion
summary: Changes how much the character's courtiers like them.
details: The game shows the word follower instead of courtier when the viewer is a landless adventurer. The amount can be negative. Works on a character.

label: Cowed vassal barter goods
summary: Adds a flat amount to the base barter goods contribution of the character's cowed vassals.
details: The game text calls this the base contribution. Cowed is a state of a vassal in the game. Works on a character.

label: Cowed vassal barter goods (percent)
summary: Changes by a percentage the barter goods contribution of the character's cowed vassals.
details: Scales the contribution instead of adding a flat amount. Works on a character.

label: Cowed vassal herd
summary: Adds a flat amount to the base herd contribution of the character's cowed vassals.
details: The game text calls this the base contribution. Cowed is a state of a vassal in the game. Works on a character.

label: Cowed vassal herd (percent)
summary: Changes by a percentage the herd contribution of the character's cowed vassals.
details: Scales the contribution instead of adding a flat amount. Works on a character.

label: Cowed vassal levy
summary: Adds a flat amount to the base levy contribution of the character's cowed vassals.
details: The game text calls this the base contribution. Cowed is a state of a vassal in the game. Works on a character.

label: Cowed vassal levy (percent)
summary: Changes by a percentage the levy contribution of the character's cowed vassals.
details: Scales the contribution instead of adding a flat amount. Works on a character.

label: Cowed vassal piety
summary: Adds a flat amount to the base piety contribution of the character's cowed vassals.
details: The game text calls this the base contribution. Cowed is a state of a vassal in the game. Works on a character.

label: Cowed vassal piety (percent)
summary: Changes by a percentage the piety contribution of the character's cowed vassals.
details: Scales the contribution instead of adding a flat amount. Works on a character.

label: Cowed vassal prestige
summary: Adds a flat amount to the base prestige contribution of the character's cowed vassals.
details: The game text calls this the base contribution. Cowed is a state of a vassal in the game. Works on a character.

label: Cowed vassal prestige (percent)
summary: Changes by a percentage the prestige contribution of the character's cowed vassals.
details: Scales the contribution instead of adding a flat amount. Works on a character.

label: Cowed vassal tax
summary: Adds a flat amount to the base tax contribution of the character's cowed vassals.
details: The game text calls this the base contribution. Cowed is a state of a vassal in the game. Works on a character.

label: Cowed vassal tax (percent)
summary: Changes by a percentage the tax contribution of the character's cowed vassals.
details: Scales the contribution instead of adding a flat amount. Works on a character.

label: Cultural acceptance gain
summary: Changes by a percentage how fast a culture gains cultural acceptance.
details: It works on a culture, not on a character.

label: Head of culture acceptance gain
summary: Changes by a percentage the cultural acceptance gain, through a character.
details: The game text is the same as for the culture version. Going by its name, it applies to the character who is the head of their culture. Works on a character.

label: Head of culture fascination
summary: Adds a flat amount to a fascination value tied to the head of a culture.
details: The game gives no display text and the input shows no vanilla use. This explanation rests on the name only. Works on a character.

label: Head of culture fascination (percent)
summary: Changes by a percentage a fascination value tied to the head of a culture.
details: The game gives no display text and the input shows no vanilla use. This explanation rests on the name only. Works on a character.

label: Innovation progress from spread
summary: Adds to the chance of innovation progress that a culture gets from spread.
details: The game text is innovation progress chance from spread. The amount is added flat. Works on a culture.

label: Maximum traditions
summary: Adds to the maximum number of traditions a culture can have.
details: The game's display text is Maximum Traditions. A negative amount lowers the maximum. Works on a culture.

label: Defender advantage
summary: Changes the defender advantage of the character's armies.
details: The game text is Defender Advantage. Going by the name, it applies when the character's side is defending. Works on a character.

label: Defender holding advantage
summary: Changes the defender advantage that applies to holdings.
details: The game text is Defender Holding Advantage. Going by the name, it applies when defending a holding. Works on a character, a province or a county.

label: Defender winter advantage
summary: Changes the defender advantage in provinces affected by winter.
details: Works on a province.

label: Development decline
summary: Changes how fast development drops each month.
details: The game text is the same as for the factor version. Going by names only, this one is a flat amount. Works on a character, a province or a county.

label: Development decline (factor)
summary: Scales how fast development drops each month.
details: Going by its name, it multiplies the decline rather than adding to it. The game text is the same as for the flat version. Works on a character, a province or a county.

label: Development growth
summary: Changes how fast development grows.
details: Vanilla special buildings give it values such as 0.15. Going by its name, it is the flat counterpart of the factor version. Works on a character, a province or a county.

label: Development growth (factor)
summary: Scales how fast development grows.
details: Going by its name, it multiplies the growth rather than adding to it. The game has no description of its own for it. Works on a character, a province or a county.

label: Different culture opinion
summary: Changes how much people of a different culture like the character.
details: The amount can be negative. Works on a character.

label: Different faith county opinion
summary: Changes by a percentage a county opinion effect tied to a different faith.
details: The game has no description for it, so this rests on the name. Works on a character and on a county.

label: Faith county opinion, baron
summary: Changes a county opinion effect tied to a different faith by a percentage, also for a baron.
details: Going by its name, it is the version that also applies when the character is only a baron. Works on a character.

label: Different faith liege opinion
summary: Changes how much a vassal of a different faith likes the character as their liege.
details: The amount can be negative. Works on a character.

label: Different faith opinion
summary: Changes how much people of a different faith like the character.
details: The amount can be negative. Works on a character.

label: Different faith suzerain opinion
summary: Changes how much subjects of a different faith like the character as their suzerain.
details: The amount can be negative. Works on a character.

label: Diplomacy
summary: Adds a flat amount to the character's Diplomacy skill.
details: A negative amount lowers it. Works on a character.

label: Diplomacy (percent)
summary: Changes the character's Diplomacy skill by a percentage.
details: Scales the skill instead of adding a flat amount. Works on a character.

label: Diplomacy per influence level
summary: Adds to Diplomacy for each influence level the character has.
details: Going by the name, the amount applies once per level. Works on a character.

label: Diplomacy per merit level
summary: Adds to Diplomacy for each merit level the character has.
details: Going by the name, the amount applies once per level. Works on a character.

label: Diplomacy per piety level
summary: Adds to Diplomacy for each piety level the character has.
details: Going by the name, the amount applies once per level. Works on a character.

label: Diplomacy per prestige level
summary: Adds to Diplomacy for each prestige level the character has.
details: Going by the name, the amount applies once per level. Works on a character.

label: Diplomacy per stress level
summary: Adds to Diplomacy for each stress level the character has.
details: Going by the name, the amount applies once per level, so a negative amount makes higher stress hurt Diplomacy. Works on a character.

label: Diplomatic scheme speed
summary: Changes the phase duration of the character's diplomatic schemes.
details: The game text calls it diplomatic scheme speed. Going by the name, a shorter phase means a faster scheme. Works on a character.

label: Diplomatic scheme resistance
summary: Changes the character's diplomatic scheme resistance.
details: The game text is Diplomatic Scheme Resistance. Going by the name, it makes diplomatic schemes against the character harder or easier to succeed. Works on a character.

label: Diplomatic range
summary: Changes by a percentage the character's diplomatic range.
details: The game's display text is the diplomatic range concept. Works on a character.

label: Direct vassal opinion
summary: Changes how much the character's direct vassals like them.
details: The amount can be negative. Works on a character.

label: Domain limit
summary: Adds a flat amount to the character's domain limit.
details: The game's display text is the domain limit concept. A negative amount lowers it. Works on a character.

label: Maximum domain limit
summary: Changes the maximum domain limit of the character.
details: The game text is Maximum Domain Limit. Works on a character.

label: Minimum domain limit
summary: Changes the minimum domain limit of the character.
details: The game text is Minimum Domain Limit. Works on a character.

label: Domain tax, different faith
summary: Changes by a percentage the domain taxes in the different-faith case.
details: The game text is Domain Taxes (Different Faith). Works on a character.

label: Other-faith tax, baron
summary: Changes domain taxes in the different-faith case by a percentage, also for a baron.
details: The game text points to the plain version. Going by its name, it also applies when the character is only a baron. Works on a character.

label: Domain tax
summary: Changes by a percentage the character's domain taxes.
details: The game text is Domain Taxes. Works on a character.

label: Domain tax (even if baron)
summary: Changes domain taxes by a percentage, also for a baron.
details: The game text points to the plain version. Going by its name, it also applies when the character is only a baron. Works on a character.

label: Domain tax, same faith
summary: Changes by a percentage the domain taxes in the same-faith case.
details: The game text is Domain Taxes (Same Faith). Works on a character.

label: Same-faith tax, baron
summary: Changes domain taxes in the same-faith case by a percentage, also for a baron.
details: The game text points to the plain version. Going by its name, it also applies when the character is only a baron. Works on a character.

label: Domicile building cost
summary: Changes the gold cost of constructing domicile buildings.
details: The game text is Domicile Building Construction Cost. A negative amount makes them cheaper. Works on a character.

label: Domicile build speed
summary: Changes how fast domicile buildings are constructed.
details: The game gives no display text, so this rests on the name. Works on a character.

label: Domicile building slots
summary: Adds a flat number of domicile building slots.
details: The game text is Number of Domicile Building Slots. Works on a character.

label: Domicile gold income
summary: Adds a flat amount to the domicile's gold income each month.
details: A negative amount lowers it. Works on a character.

label: Domicile gold income (percent)
summary: Changes by a percentage the domicile's monthly gold income.
details: Scales the income instead of adding a flat amount. Works on a character.

label: Domicile herd
summary: Adds a flat amount of herd from the domicile each month.
details: A negative amount lowers it. Works on a character.

label: Domicile herd (percent)
summary: Changes by a percentage the monthly herd from the domicile.
details: Scales the amount instead of adding a flat one. Works on a character.

label: Domicile influence
summary: Adds a flat amount of influence from the domicile each month.
details: A negative amount lowers it. Works on a character.

label: Domicile influence (percent)
summary: Changes by a percentage the monthly influence from the domicile.
details: Scales the amount instead of adding a flat one. Works on a character.

label: Domicile piety
summary: Adds a flat amount of piety from the domicile each month.
details: A negative amount lowers it. Works on a character.

label: Domicile piety (percent)
summary: Changes by a percentage the monthly piety from the domicile.
details: Scales the amount instead of adding a flat one. Works on a character.

label: Domicile prestige
summary: Adds a flat amount of prestige from the domicile each month.
details: A negative amount lowers it. Works on a character.

label: Domicile prestige (percent)
summary: Changes by a percentage the monthly prestige from the domicile.
details: Scales the amount instead of adding a flat one. Works on a character.

label: Domicile travel speed
summary: Changes the domicile travel speed.
details: The game uses its domicile travel speed concept as the display text. Works on a character.

label: Natural dread
summary: Adds to the character's natural dread.
details: The game text is Natural Dread. Works on a character.

label: Dread decay
summary: Changes by a flat amount how fast the character's dread decays.
details: The game text is Dread Decay. Works on a character.

label: Dread decay (percent)
summary: Changes by a percentage how fast the character's dread decays.
details: Scales the decay instead of adding a flat amount. Works on a character.
